DocumentProperties.description:
Layout features that make a PDF hard to parse. Each flag is true when present.

Filled by hand in the manifest after inspecting the PDF, and detected by the Profiler at
run time, so the two can be compared.

formulas.description: Has mathematical notation beyond inline numbers.
formulas.title: Formulas

images.description: Has charts, figures or photos with information in them.
images.title: Images

multi_column.description: Body text is laid out in two or more columns.
multi_column.title: Multi Column

scanned.description: Pages are images without a text layer; needs OCR.
scanned.title: Scanned

tables.description: Has data tables whose structure carries meaning.
tables.title: Tables

DocumentProperties.title: DocumentProperties

description:
One document of the benchmark corpus, pinned to an exact version.

The PDF itself is never committed (redistribution rights): `make corpus` downloads it from
`url` and refuses it unless its SHA-256 matches `sha256`.

id.description: Stable kebab-case slug; golden sets and results reference it.
id.title: Id

language.description: ISO 639-1 code of the main language, e.g. `en`.
language.title: Language

notes.description: Anything a benchmark reader should know.
notes.title: Notes

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the PDF bytes.
sha256.title: Sha256

url.description: Direct download URL of the pinned version.
url.title: Url

title: CorpusEntry
